what: Label Explorer engine vs published NTA 8800 results for the RVO BENG reference house 'woning L vrij' (detached, 8 x 11 m, two storeys + 45 deg pitched roof with heated attic, Ag 181 m2, Als/Ag 2.14)

sources.results: RVO / DGMR (2021) BENG voorbeeldconcepten woningbouw, bijlage 1 (concepts) and bijlage 3 (BENG 1 sensitivity), https://rvo.nl/sites/default/files/2021/07/beng-voorbeeldconcepten-woningbouw.pdf
sources.geometry: RVO / DGMR (2016) Referentiegebouwen BENG, table 1 and section 4.3, https://www.rvo.nl/sites/default/files/2017/02/Referentiegebouwen%20BENG.pdf
sources.inputs: Rockwool BENG reference sheet 'vrijstaande woning L': Rc 3.7/4.7/6.3, Uw 1.4, g 0.6, qv10 0.4, forfaitaire psi

inputs_used: Rc set exactly by insulation thickness; glass 27% of each facade; n50 1.6 /h (from qv10 0.4); thermal bridges 'not detailed' (+0.10 W/m2K); air-to-water heat pump, floor heating, exhaust ventilation

beng1_heating_plus_cooling_kWh_m2.case: passive envelope + triple glass (our Rc 6/7/8 is a guess of the passive package)

beng2_ep_fossil_kWh_m2.case: air-to-water heat pump, exhaust ventilation C4c, 2,100 Wp PV (west in the reference, south-ish in the engine)

calibration_made: cooling need added (BENG 1 = heating + cooling); summer window airing +1.5 /h in the cooling balance
thermal mass classes 250 / 180 / 130 / 90 kJ/m2K (NTA reference uses 130 for mixed light)
heated attic under a pitched roof counted in floor area and volume
heat-pump SCOP lowered to in-use seasonal values (air-water 3.4 at 35 C)
emission + distribution losses 10%, hydronic pump 150 kWh/yr
remaining_gap: BENG 2 is ~30% low. Likely causes: NTA 8800 usage conventions (ventilation rate, hot water, internal gains, still unknown, OPEN_DATA_GAPS A2), PV orientation, NTA heat-pump and auxiliary defaults. The user's own single-family run (A1) is the next check.
